description: This file defines a trait named 'I18NHelperTrait' within the namespace 'OrangeHRM\I18N\Traits\Service'. The trait provides a method to retrieve an instance of 'I18NHelper' service from a dependency injection container, utilizing the 'ServiceContainerTrait'. The file serves as a reusable component to be used in other service classes for accessing internationalization helper functionalities.

methods.name: getI18NHelper
methods.description: Returns an instance of I18NHelper by retrieving it from the dependency injection container.
